recognize_zh: 皮膚穿刺切片低倍下，真皮從表皮下方至深層幾乎被密集、深紫藍色的瀰漫性淋巴樣浸潤佔滿，僅少量膠原束夾雜，表皮下幾乎沒有明顯的無浸潤帶，符合腿型原發皮膚瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤的分布。
features: Skin punch biopsy with dense diffuse basophilic infiltrate filling the entire dermis
Infiltrate extends from the superficial papillary dermis to the deep margin
Little to no uninvolved grenz zone beneath the epidermis
Residual collagen bundles and adnexal structures entrapped within the infiltrate
Intact thin epidermis with basket-weave keratin; cytology not assessable at this power
describe_en: Low-power view of a skin punch biopsy shows a dense, diffuse, monotonous-appearing lymphoid infiltrate occupying the full thickness of the dermis and extending to the deep margin, with entrapped collagen bundles. The infiltrate closely abuts the overlying intact epidermis with little to no grenz zone. Cytologic features cannot be evaluated at this magnification. The pattern is consistent with a cutaneous lymphoma and, with large cell cytology and a CD20+, BCL2+, MUM1+ phenotype, supports primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leg type.

ddx.vs: PCFCL shows centrocytes and centroblasts, often with follicular remnants, and is typically BCL2 negative/weak and MUM1 negative, favoring head and trunk sites.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous marginal zone lymphoproliferative disorder
ddx.vs: PCMZL is composed of small marginal zone cells and plasma cells in nodular/diffuse patterns with reactive germinal centers, not sheets of large cells.
Myeloid or BPDCN infiltrates are CD20 negative and express myeloid markers or CD4/CD56/CD123.
